headline: SEA @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.50 at BAL 3.51, with a projected total of 8.01. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.52 runs while BAL moved +0.14, changing the projected margin by +0.38 runs. The projected total climbed +0.65, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Emerson Hancock has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Pete Alonso, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Victor Robles, Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
